name: Osteitis Pubis
definition: Painful noninfectious stress/inflammatory disorder of the pubic symphysis and surrounding aponeurotic structures.

investigations.principle: MRI can demonstrate symphyseal marrow edema and aponeurotic pathology in persistent cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Fever/systemic inflammation requires exclusion of infection.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Shroni Shotha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful noninfectious stress/inflammatory disorder of the pubic symphysis and surrounding aponeurotic structures.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
